katas.title: Workspace slugs: collapse repeated dashes and strip leading/trailing ones

seededDefectKey.scenario: Workspace "acme-co" exists; a user creates a workspace with slug "Acme  Co" (two spaces) or "acme--co".
seededDefectKey.consequence: The service still prechecks with its own copy of the old rule, so it looks up "acme--co", finds nothing and proceeds; Workspace.Create stores "acme-co". The insert hits the unique index, and the recovery query (also "acme--co") again finds nothing, so the DbUpdateException is rethrown: the caller gets a 500 instead of the 409 "slug already taken".

seededDefectKey.scenario: The domain rule changed in one place only.
seededDefectKey.consequence: Precheck, insert and recovery no longer agree on the key; the conflict classification that the comment in WorkspaceService promises is silently broken (and a slug of only dashes now normalizes to "", which Guard no longer catches).

seededDefectKey.scenario: The duplicated rule is already in the shipped service.
seededDefectKey.consequence: Review finding A names exactly this change ("say, collapsing repeated dashes") as the way the two copies drift; the fix is one normalization function used in all three places.
